topics.why_in_news: Government launched large-scale HPV vaccination campaign targeting adolescent girls to reduce cervical cancer burden and strengthen preventive healthcare in India.
prelims_quick_notes: HPV vaccine protects against Human Papillomavirus infection.
Cervical cancer is among the leading cancers affecting women in India.
Campaign targets adolescent girls before exposure to HPV infection.
Vaccination linked with preventive healthcare and women’s health.
Implemented through school-based and public health outreach programmes.
Supports Universal Immunisation and preventive healthcare expansion.
India also launched indigenous Td vaccine production initiatives.
Focus on awareness, early prevention and public health coverage.
important_facts: Persistent HPV infection is major cause of cervical cancer.
WHO promotes cervical cancer elimination strategy.
National Vaccination Day observed on 16 March.
ASHA and Anganwadi workers support last-mile awareness and delivery.
exam_relevance: Important for Health, Women Empowerment and Social Justice.
Useful for preventive healthcare, SDGs and public health governance.
Can be linked with Article 21 and Article 47.
prelims_traps: HPV vaccine is preventive, not curative.
Cervical cancer is caused mainly by persistent HPV infection.
Vaccination programmes require both awareness and healthcare infrastructure.

topics.why_in_news: India celebrated National Vaccination Day highlighting achievements of Universal Immunisation Programme, Mission Indradhanush and expansion of preventive healthcare coverage.
prelims_quick_notes: National Vaccination Day observed on 16 March.
Universal Immunisation Programme is among the world’s largest public health programmes.
Mission Indradhanush launched to improve immunisation coverage.
Focus on zero-dose children and vulnerable populations.
Vaccination reduces Infant Mortality Rate and Maternal Mortality Rate.
ASHA and Anganwadi workers support last-mile vaccine delivery.
Supports disease elimination and preventive healthcare.
Strengthens public health infrastructure and awareness.
important_facts: UIP covers pregnant women and children across India.
WHO supports global immunisation and disease eradication programmes.
Vaccination contributes to demographic dividend and human capital development.
Cold-chain systems are essential for vaccine storage and transportation.
exam_relevance: Important for Social Justice, Health and Governance.
Useful for preventive healthcare and human development topics.
Can be linked with Article 21, Article 47 and SDGs.
prelims_traps: Vaccination programmes require awareness and delivery infrastructure together.
Mission Indradhanush is part of immunisation strengthening, not a separate healthcare system.
Preventive healthcare reduces long-term healthcare burden.

topics.why_in_news: Government highlighted achievements of Mission Indradhanush in improving immunisation coverage and reaching left-out and underserved populations across India.
prelims_quick_notes: Mission Indradhanush launched in 2015.
Aims to achieve full immunisation coverage.
Targets children and pregnant women left out of routine immunisation.
Focuses on low-coverage districts and vulnerable populations.
Intensified Mission Indradhanush launched for accelerated coverage.
Supports reduction of vaccine-preventable diseases.
Implemented under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
Uses convergence model involving ASHA, ANM and Anganwadi workers.
important_facts: Named after seven vaccine-preventable diseases initially targeted.
Focus on urban slums, tribal areas, nomadic groups and hard-to-reach populations.
Helps reduce Infant Mortality Rate and Maternal Mortality Rate.
Uses micro-planning and last-mile healthcare delivery approach.
exam_relevance: Important for Social Justice, Health and Governance.
Useful for public health delivery and inclusive development topics.
Can be linked with SDGs and preventive healthcare.
prelims_traps: Mission Indradhanush is not separate from UIP.
Targets both children and pregnant women.
Focus is on full immunisation coverage, not only awareness campaigns.
